# E0349: staging annotation on a value known only at run time

`comptime` asserts that a value is known while compiling, which this one isn't. Delete `comptime`, which changes nothing the program does, or make the value a value parameter.

- Rule: [`meta.not-static`](../../reference/16-meta.md#meta.not-static)
- Reported at: the first part of the annotated expression that isn't static.
- Tier: `meta`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0349:2
fn report(n: i64) / io {
  comptime if n > 0 { print("positive") }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn report(n: i64) / io {
  if n > 0 { print("positive") }
}
```

Delete `comptime`, which changes nothing the program does, or make the value a
